purpose: Submit a website URL, implement a replica, independently review visual and functional parity, return a reviewable change request

requested_model.runner_engine_model_mapping: must verify with selected engine; do not assume desktop model alias is an API identifier

checks: source URL and project destination resolved
brand, repository and browser profile bound to this job
menus, modals, filters, infinite loading, product variants, gallery, cart and footer
no fabricated reviews or account history

stages.output: source/target section images + DOM geometry + browser errors
checks: full-page screenshot is never sole evidence
visual differences and functional failures both reviewed

stages.on_unresolved: mark needs-human with exact remaining findings; no automatic acceptance

stages.output: draft PR with preview link, changed files, source/target screenshots, findings and known gaps

execution.local_browser: dedicated self-hosted Windows worker when AdsPower/REA/local resources are needed
execution.concurrency: one job at a time for initial server; remaining tasks queue
execution.rate_limit: stop repeating requests after 429 and report the blocked evidence

not_yet_configured: AI engine authentication and supported model mapping
automated evidence capture and independent review jobs
